description: Eight-panel composite of EBSD orientation data arranged as two rows of four, plus a small colour key. Top row (a1-d1): inverse pole figure (IPF) unit triangles with corners labelled 001, 101 and 111, each scattered with red, green and blue dots and annotated "m_tw < m_s" together with a curved boundary line marking the twinning-favourable region. In-panel legends read Type I (red), Type II (green), Type III (blue). Titles: (a1) RT 38%, (b1) LNT 28%, (c1) LNT 38%, (d1) LNT 55%. Bottom row (a2-d2): EBSD inverse pole figure maps along the TA direction for the same four conditions, each carrying a 25 µm scale bar; a small IPF colour key with θ-threshold labels sits at the lower-left of (a2). In (d1) the blue type III dots cluster densely near the 111 corner, while (a1) shows mostly isolated red and green dots. The maps progress from coarse equiaxed grains in (a2) to a heavily subdivided, twin-lamellae-rich structure in (d2), with red-oriented grains becoming prominent in (c2) and (d2). The figure argues that twinning at LNT is orientation-dependent and increases with strain.
measured_quantities: grain orientation relative to TA (inverse pole figure)

observations.observation: The top row consists of inverse pole figure unit triangles whose corners are labelled 001, 101 and 111, each containing red, green and blue data dots.
Each top-row legend maps colours to grain types: Type I = red, Type II = green, Type III = blue.
Each top-row triangle carries the printed annotation 'm_tw < m_s' next to a curved line that separates the twinning-favourable region from the rest of the triangle.
The four conditions printed on the panels are 'RT 38%' (a1, a2), 'LNT 28%' (b1, b2), 'LNT 38%' (c1, c2) and 'LNT 55%' (d1, d2).
Every map in the bottom row (a2-d2) carries a 25 µm scale bar.
In (d1) the blue (type III) dots form a dense cluster adjacent to the 111 corner, whereas (a1) shows only sparse, mostly red and green dots without such a cluster.
The number of plotted dots increases from (a1) through (b1), (c1) to (d1), consistent with an increasing number of analysed/twinned grains as strain rises.
Map (a2) shows coarse equiaxed grains with few internal black line features, while (d2) shows a finely subdivided structure with abundant parallel black line features inside grains.
Large red-coloured grains containing dense parallel line features are visible in maps (c2) and (d2).
A small inverse pole figure colour key with two printed θ-threshold labels is inset at the lower-left of panel (a2); the labels are only partially readable at the supplied resolution.

The caption states that (a1, b1, c1, d1) are inverse pole maps along the TA direction with red, green and blue dots corresponding to type I, II and III grains, in which orientations with m_tw < m_s are labelled.
The caption states that (a2, b2, c2, d2) are also inverse pole maps along the TA direction.

The citing text defines type I as <001>//TA with an angle deviation of approximately 15°, type III as <111>//TA with an angle deviation of approximately 15°, and type II as all remaining orientations, following I. Gutierrez-Urrutia.

The citing text states that twins are more likely to occur in type II and type III grains and that at RT (38 %) the deformation is controlled by dislocation gliding because the twinned grain fraction is very small.

The citing text states that the deformation twinning fraction increases with increasing strain at LNT and that type II grains tend to form single-orientation twinning while type III grains tend to form multiple-orientation twinning in (c2).

subfigures.description: IPF unit triangle (001-101-111) titled 'RT 38%' with red, green and blue dots and the annotation 'm_tw < m_s' plus a curved region boundary; legend lists Type I red, Type II green, Type III blue. Only a few widely separated dots, mostly red and green, with a scatter of blue near the 111 corner.
IPF triangle titled 'LNT 28%' with the same legend and 'm_tw < m_s' annotation; dots (red, green and several blue) are more numerous than in (a1) and spread across the triangle.
IPF triangle titled 'LNT 38%'; dotted population includes a larger cluster of blue (type III) dots close to the 111 corner and more green (type II) dots than (b1).
IPF triangle titled 'LNT 55%'; the densest dot population of the row, dominated by a tight blue (type III) cluster at the 111 corner plus a band of green dots.

EBSD inverse pole figure map along TA for RT 38% deformation, 25 µm scale bar; coarse equiaxed grains with predominantly blue/purple and green colouring and relatively few black internal boundary lines. A small IPF colour key with θ-threshold labels is inset at the lower left.
EBSD inverse pole figure map along TA for LNT 28%, 25 µm scale bar; multicoloured equiaxed grains with black boundary lines outlining grain boundaries.
EBSD inverse pole figure map along TA for LNT 38%, 25 µm scale bar; large red and blue grains containing dense parallel black line features interpreted as twin lamellae.

EBSD inverse pole figure map along TA for LNT 55%, 25 µm scale bar; the most heavily subdivided structure of the row, with abundant fine black line features within grains and prominent red-oriented grains.
